Ujjain Mosque Dispute: Violence Erupts After Court Rejects Plea

In Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, violence erupted following the rejection of a petition against a mosque. Reports indicate stone-pelting and lathi-charge occurred after authorities attempted to remove the mosque in the morning. Police deployed tear gas and conducted lathi-charges. The city Qazi appealed to residents to ignore rumors and stay indoors. Ten First Information Reports (FIRs) were filed in connection with the incident.
